purpose: Prove a Stage 0 Aseprite/LibreSprite native tags/layers semantic subset with three frames, three semantic layers, Tags Chunk 0x2018, Layer/User Data Chunk 0x2020 bindings, and compressed RGBA cels without claiming arbitrary project schema coverage or live editor validation.

external_anchors.used_for: ASE header, frame header, Layer Chunk 0x2004, Tags Chunk 0x2018, User Data Chunk 0x2020, and compressed Cel Chunk 0x2005 layout.
LibreSprite remains a compatibility boundary; no GPL editor code is embedded.

limitations: Stage 0 Aseprite/LibreSprite tags/layers proof covers three semantic layers, three frames, one Tags chunk, and compressed RGBA cels.
Live external editor rewrite validation is not verified by this lab.

Arbitrary Aseprite project schemas, tilemaps, tilesets, linked cels, nested groups, timeline variants, and full project-format coverage remain separate; palette/slice semantics are covered by a later Stage 0 lab.
